claim_one_line: THE TOPIC SEARCH PER RESTORATION, MADE MECHANICAL. B1043 measured the defect -- a band groups arcs by BANKING DATE while a law is a statement about WHAT AN ARC SAYS, and B1039 restored as open a conjecture B564 had CLOSED -- and registered the fix as an owner decision; the decision came back to fix it as I judge best. WHY IT IS AN INSTRUMENT AND NOT A RULE: the obvious fix is the one B1043 named (keep the band sweep, add a topic search per law at restoration time), and WRITTEN AS A RULE IT WOULD HAVE JOINED THE OTHERS -- this refresh's own findings say so twice, Review 42 having prescribed 'a partial run is not a run' which recurred within two days (B1041), and THE_LADDER's X31 having named self-inflation which recurred ten times across nine arcs (B1042). NAMING IS NOT GATING, so the fix is a sweeper, a registry and a gate: scripts/checks/law_siblings.py, docs/consolidation/LAW_SIBLINGS.md, and the gate law-siblings, the 27th. THE POSTURE IS TAKEN FROM THE REPO RATHER THAN INVENTED: candidates are TRIAGED, NOT CAPPED, the corpus's own posture for this shape (B821/B823, the blind-arc gate, 'this gate fails only on UNTRIAGED arcs -- it asks for a judgement, not a number'), because a hard-fail on every candidate would FIRE ON RIGHT ANSWERS AND TRAIN READERS TO IGNORE IT, which is E34's recorded reason for leaving a related class ungated; and the gate FAILS CLOSED if the sweeper disappears, a missing sweeper being exactly the state in which a restored law quietly leaves its siblings behind. WHAT IT FOUND: seven candidates across four restored laws, with isomonodromy at ZERO as the control showing a law CAN be band-local. SIX CONSOLIDATED onto their laws' rows, retiring the debt -- B33 (the SPECTRAL face of the tower's module law at n = 2,3), B232 (THE SAME LAW DIFFERENTIATED, the step form being the difference of the band form, verified n = 3..12), B522 (the filtration theorem, 'full proof NOT reached' but THE BEST KNOWN PROGRESS ON THE VERY PRIZE B1038'S ROW LISTED AS OPEN, which the row did not say), B75 (degree=rank as a two-parameter (m,n) phenomenon, the FIRST statement that the exponent is not rank-bound), B77 (the signed scalar law [A,B] = (-1)^{n-1} mu^n, THE SIGN HALF of [A,B] = +/- mu^k), and B106 (Dehn-filling fixed points with root-of-unity neutral eigenvalues, EXACTLY THE FINITE-ORDER-MU STRATUM B198's own correction blames for the illusory multi-exponent readings, i.e. the stratum the law must be read OFF). ONE LEFT IN DEBT DELIBERATELY: B257 is RELATED, sharing the discriminant/branch-point vocabulary but stating a fact about the EUCLIDEAN TRANSITION rather than the peripheral exponent -- the fingerprint matched a word, not a statement -- so it stays a candidate, triaged, AND STILL IN DEBT, because it is owed a row of its own on a different law. A registry that only ever says 'same law, consolidate it' is a rubber stamp; this one disposes BOTH WAYS on its first use. TWO SELF-MEASUREMENT BITES INSIDE THE INSTRUMENT BUILT AGAINST THIS CLASS'S COUSIN: (1) B1043's LAW_MAP row names every candidate, so the sweeper's FIRST RUN REPORTED ZERO -- rows that REGISTER debt read as rows that CONSOLIDATE it, which is E37 in the tool; (2) the obvious fix was WRONG AND MADE THINGS WORSE, since dropping any line that names the registrar also drops THAT ROW'S REAL CITATIONS -- a LAW_MAP row is ONE LINE -- so B117, B122, B121 and B118 abruptly read as uncited, caught because the candidate count went UP from 7 to 10. Both fixed by excluding registry rows BY PURPOSE (their headline) rather than by mention; and the same trap decided where B257's judgement lives, since naming it on LAW_MAP would make an unconsolidated arc READ AS CONSOLIDATED, so the judgement sits in the registry and the arc stays in debt where it belongs. 9 checks; 6 locks; 27 GATES GREEN -- and the 27th was caught missing from PRACTICES.md by the practices-register gate within a minute of being added, which is the machinery doing precisely its job. WHAT THIS DOES NOT DO: it does NOT re-disposition the corpus by topic, L164's larger option, which would re-open every closed band; it makes the PER-RESTORATION check mechanical, which is the cheap half, and the half that would have caught B564 for the price of one grep.
